major_row_policy.unsupported_mapping: unresolved; no label or tag-name guessing
major_row_policy.missing_value_policy: Never fill zero; distinguish missing, unresolved, unsupported and not_applicable with reason
major_row_policy.annual_comparability: Exact duration/instant, issuer, currency/unit, consolidation, dimensions and security scope; 52/53-week and fiscal-calendar differences remain visible
major_row_policy.cash_definition: Keep cash-flow cash definition and balance-sheet cash separate; no assumed FX zero
major_row_policy.sign_and_precision: Source Inline XBRL sign/scale/decimals and actual printed statement; Decimal and versioned reported-precision tolerance
major_row_policy.version_selection: fact-level cutoff; preserve all candidates; latest eligible publication per exact fact key; scope unknown refuses amendment replacement; Part III does not replace unrelated facts

required_resource_identity.runtime_profile_requirement: Use a reviewed exact profile with complete applicable EFM/DQC, exact per-original taxonomy namespace and immutable resource hashes. Profile availability is not established by this fixture. Historical namespaces require their compatible full rules, not a renamed modern binding.
